detail.anchor_text:
The primary antibodies were as follows: anti-STAT3, p-STAT3 (Tyr705), IL6ST (Gp130), E-
cadherin, Vimentin (R28), ZEB1, Snail, Axl, AKT, p-AKT (Ser473), p44/p42 mitogen-
activated protein kinase (ERK), p-p44/p42 MAPK (p-ERK1/2), JAK1, p-JAK1, JAK2, p-
JAK2, JAK3, Tyk2 (a JAK family menber), PARP, and c-PARP (Cell Signaling Technology)
and IL6R, OSMR, and LIFR (Santa Cruz Biotechnology).
